name: PlayTorrio iOS (Unofficial AltStore Source)
subtitle: Your Ultimate Entertainment Hub — unofficial AltStore-compatible source for iOS / iPadOS.
description: An unofficial AltStore source for PlayTorrio on iOS / iPadOS, compatible with any signing app that consumes the standard AltStore source format (Feather, AltStore Classic, AltStore PAL, ESign, Scarlet, Sideloadly, and others). PlayTorrio is an open source entertainment platform: stream, download, and enjoy movies, shows, games, music, books, manga, and more — all in one beautiful, powerful application. IPAs are served directly from the project's public GitHub releases. This is an unofficial community source and is not affiliated with or supported by the PlayTorrio developers.

apps.localizedDescription: PlayTorrio — an open source entertainment platform. Stream, download, and enjoy movies, shows, games, music, books, manga, and more, all in one beautiful, powerful application. Includes a built-in torrent engine, WebTorrent support, debrid provider integration (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, Debrid-Link), IPTV with M3U playlist and EPG support, Trakt sync, anime and Asian drama sections, comics and manga, audiobooks, and a media downloader. Requires iPhone and iPad, iOS 13.0+.
